expectedMaterial.source: Geometry: AISC Shapes Database v16.0 (Aug 2023; file SHA-256 82D0CEB96A0D938AE1A6BD9637CB10A1E269225B5D668DCE5B0BDC8D86013496), row W12X26 as published: A 7.65 in2, Ix 204 in4, Iy 17.3 in4, J 0.300 in4; independent derivation within 0.24 %. Material: ASTM A992/A992M Grade 50 (current ASTM edition A992/A992M-22). E 29000 ksi and nu 0.30: modeling conventions for structural steel accepted at verification; primary citation not read in I-65. Unit weight 490 pcf: steel density implied by the AISC v16.0 HSS nominal weights (median 490.00 pcf). RAM: United States/W/W 12X26, material A992 Gr50 (E 29000 ksi, nu 0.3, 486.94 pcf). DIF-01: RAM unit weight -0.62 %, informative only for the pilot transfer test without self weight; RAM values are not equivalent for later analyses. RAM catalog formal edition not verified. Ref: I-65 F4 engineering approval package.
